summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and visual engineering implementation plan to recreate the SGS AI Group official corporate website strictly adhering to the approved visual master mockup (/public/assets/aistudio/SGS_AI_Group_Portfolio_Showcase_e406d3e2.png). Covers the 6 master sections, horizontal slider for Industries, interactive Selected Work categories with the high-end case study modal overlay, NIRA AI World hero with showreel video teaser modal, verified SGS corporate contact details, and Cloudflare Pages static export compatibility.
